name.ja: <ruby>騎<rt>き</rt></ruby><ruby>士<rt>し</rt></ruby>の<ruby>称<rt>しょう</rt></ruby><ruby>号<rt>ごう</rt></ruby>

effect.en: Send 1 Spellcaster Type monster from your hand or 1 face-up Spellcaster Type monster from your field to the Graveyard. Then, if you have "Dark Magician" in your Graveyard, you can Special Summon 1 "Dark Magician Knight" from your hand or Graveyard face-up to your field.
